review:
Dragon Age Hold & Win is a 5x3, 25-line Asian fantasy slot starring a shape-shifting heroine who turns into an amber dragon. It has two bonus games.

Free spins are triggered by three or more scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5. The Gold Respin game is activated by six or more coins, in either the base game or free spins, and uses Plus Spin and Collect symbols, with a Mega jackpot of 5,000x the bet. BGaming lists a maximum multiplier of 5,624x and an RTP of 96.14%; it doesn't publish a volatility rating for this title. Free spins arrive about once every 182 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
